Goals/Education
1.  What is/are your short-term goal(s) for this
client/patient?
2.  For each goal, state the expected outcome(s)
of dietary compliance as behavioral objectives 
for change, or expected outcome of the
nutrition support. (Remember that outcomes 
should be measurable; specify a time frame 
and criterion [by how much], and encourage
client participation, if possible.)
•  Nutrition support to be recommended (when it is a

•  Visuals, models, printed material to be given or 
used, if appropriate.

•  Patient will eat whole-grain bread instead of

additional fruit and vegetable every day.
•  Patient will be given a handout on whole-grain 
products.

and evaluation (When and how will you evaluate
